burns_step1: Remove the person from the heat source immediately.
burns_step2: If their clothing is on fire, have them STOP, DROP, and ROLL.
burns_step3: Hold the burned area under cool (not cold) running water or apply a cool, wet compress for 10 to 15 minutes.
burns_step4: Do NOT use ice. It can cause further tissue damage.
burns_step5: Remove rings or other tight items from the burned area quickly and gently, before it swells.
burns_step6: Cover the burn loosely with a sterile, non-fluffy bandage or clean cloth.
burns_danger1: Never apply ice, butter, or ointments to a severe burn.
cardiac_step1: If the person is unresponsive and not breathing, begin chest compressions while someone else fetches the AED (Automated External Defibrillator).
choking_step1: Ask: "Are you choking?" If they can cough forcefully or speak, DO NOT interfere. Encourage them to cough.
choking_step2: If they cannot speak, cough, or breathe, act immediately.
choking_step3: Stand to the side and just behind the person.
choking_step4: Support their chest with one hand and lean them forward.
choking_step5: Give 5 firm strikes between their shoulder blades with the heel of your other hand.
choking_step6: Stand behind the person. Wrap your arms around their waist.
choking_step7: Make a fist with one hand. Place the thumb side slightly above their navel.
choking_step8: Grasp your fist with your other hand. Give quick, upward thrusts as if trying to lift them.
choking_step9: Alternate back blows and abdominal thrusts until the object is forced out or the person becomes unconscious.
earthquake_step1: Stay there and cover your head and neck with a pillow.
earthquake_step2: Do not try to move. Broken glass on the floor is a common cause of injury.
earthquake_step5: Evacuate the building if you smell gas or see structural damage. Use stairs, NOT elevators.
flood_step1: If water is rising, immediately move to a higher floor.
flood_step2: Do not try to walk or swim through moving water. Even 6 inches of fast-moving water can knock you down.
flood_step3: Turn off the main power switch if you can safely reach it WITHOUT stepping in water.
flood_step4: Do not climb into a closed attic where you could become trapped. Go onto the roof only if necessary.
gas_leak_step1: Leave the area immediately. Do not stay to find the source.
gas_leak_step3: If a chemical spills on your skin, immediately flush the area with copious amounts of water for at least 15 minutes.
gas_leak_step5: If fumes are present, cover your mouth and nose with a damp cloth if possible and seek fresh air.
security_step1: If there is an accessible escape path, attempt to evacuate the premises.
security_step3: Help others escape, if possible, but keep moving.
security_step4: Keep your hands visible when encountering law enforcement.
security_step5: If evacuation is not possible, find a place to hide where the active threat is less likely to find you.
security_step6: Hide behind large items (e.g., cabinets, desks).
security_step8: As a last resort, and only when your life is in imminent danger, attempt to disrupt or incapacitate the threat.
security_step9: Act as aggressively as possible against the attacker.
wounds_step1: Apply direct, firm pressure to the wound with a clean cloth, tissue, or piece of clothing.
wounds_step2: Do not remove the cloth if blood soaks through. Add another layer on top and continue applying pressure.
wounds_step3: If the wound is on an arm or leg, raise it above the level of the heart if possible, while maintaining direct pressure.
wounds_step5: Elevate their legs slightly (unless you suspect a head, neck, or back injury, or broken leg).
wounds_step6: Keep them warm with a coat or blanket. Do not give them anything to eat or drink.
other_step1: Take a deep breath. Panic leads to poor decision making.
other_step2: Assess your surroundings for immediate dangers.
other_step3: Staff and emergency responders have been notified via this app.
other_step4: Follow any instructions pushed to your device or announced over the PA system.
other_step5: Keep your phone on and with you.
other_step6: Do not tie up phone lines except to provide critical updates to emergency services.
